name: Pure MSE Velocity
tagline: Floor baseline: clean per-sample MSE between predicted and target mean velocity, no reweighting.
diff_from_baseline: MeanFlow / flow-matching default loss. Plain mean-squared error on the predicted mean velocity, with no auxiliary perceptual or frequency term and no inverse-loss reweighting. Establishes the velocity-MSE floor.

name: Spatial Perceptual Stack
tagline: Velocity MSE + Charbonnier + (LPIPS, Sobel-grad, multiscale-L1) on the implied denoised image, weighted by (1-t)^2.
formula: $$\mathcal{L} = \underbrace{\|\hat v - v^{*}\|_2^2}_{\text{MSE}} + 0.1\,\underbrace{\sqrt{(\hat v-v^{*})^2+\epsilon^2}}_{\text{Charbonnier}} + (1-t)^2\,\mathbf{1}_{t>0.1}\!\left[0.5\,\mathrm{LPIPS}(\hat x_0,x) + 0.3\,\|\nabla \hat x_0 - \nabla x\|_1 + 0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{ms}(\hat x_0,x)\right]$$
diff_from_baseline: Composite spatial-domain perceptual recipe. LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018) + Sobel-gradient L1 + multiscale L1 + Charbonnier (Lai et al., 2017) on the implied denoised image $\hat x_0=x_t - t\hat v$, gated to low-noise timesteps. Strong spatial-only baseline.

name: Spatial+Frequency Stack
tagline: Spatial perceptual stack (LPIPS+Sobel+multiscale) extended with an FFT-magnitude L1 term covering the global frequency spectrum.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a spectral term (Mathieu et al., 2016 / Fuoli et al., 2021): L1 on the magnitude of the 2D rFFT of the denoised image vs. ground truth, on top of LPIPS+Sobel+multiscale. Combined spatial+frequency perceptual baseline.
